entries.title: Three surfaces that advertised a product we were not running
entries.summary: A config comment describing a precedence the resolver did not use, a tool schema naming three key-requiring embedding providers while hiding the free bundled one, and a guide listing a tool the same process refuses to dispatch. In each case the code was fine and the thing describing it was not.

entries.title: Five answers that were asserted, not established
entries.summary: Five fixes, each one a place that reported a result it had not checked: a cache that said ready, an index that said fresh, a resolver that said this repository, an opt-out that said applied, and an embedding store that said one model. Three of the five were a comment or docstring describing behaviour the code did not implement.

entries.title: A documented setting the storage layer never read
entries.summary: The env table documents `CODE_INDEX_PATH` as "Index storage location", and `config.py`, `process_registry.py`, `install_pack.py`, `receipt.py` and two `server.py` sites all read it. `IndexStore`, `SQLiteIndexStore` and `process_locks._lock_dir` hardcoded `Path.home() / ".code-index"` and ignored
